create_batched_jittable_env: create a BatchedJittableEnvironment wrapper with an env class, batch size, and config settings
run_batched_env_step: run a batched environment step using vmapped actions on a list of EnvState objects
reset_batched_env: reset a batch of environments by splitting an RNG key across the batch size
get_single_action_spec: get the single action spec as a BoundedArray with min zero and max num_actions minus one
get_single_observation_spec: get the single observation spec as a dictionary with an observation Array entry
